products_listed_complete.name: products_listed_complete
products_listed_complete.value: "products"."status" IN ('draft', 'archived') OR ("products"."price_fils" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."category_id" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

repair_events_status_change.name: repair_events_status_change
repair_events_status_change.value: "repair_events"."kind" NOT IN ('status', 'correction') OR "repair_events"."to_status" IS NOT NULL

repair_quotes_decision.name: repair_quotes_decision
repair_quotes_decision.value: ("repair_quotes"."decided_at" IS NULL) = ("repair_quotes"."decision_method" IS NULL) AND ("repair_quotes"."status" <> 'pending' OR "repair_quotes"."decided_at" IS NULL) AND ("repair_quotes"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'declined') OR "repair_quotes"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)
